scripts.dev: backend/node_modules/.bin/concurrently --kill-others -n backend,assets,frontend "php backend/artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "npm --prefix backend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && composer --working-dir=backend check
